context: Train-station koban. A child has gotten separated from his mom at rush hour. Takeda has been giving him juice while they wait. Then his mom arrives, half-running.
purpose: three-speaker — kid, calming officer, panicking parent

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: もうすぐ、お母さん来るからね。
lines.style: Calm crouched voice. Slides a juice across the desk.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A small one-syllable. Hands holding the juice carefully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: しょう！しょう！…ああ、本当にすみません！
lines.en: Sho! Sho! …Oh — truly, I'm so sorry!
lines.style: Half-running breathless. Apology and relief flooding together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A small bright voice. Stands up too fast in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 迷子になっちゃって、本当に、ご迷惑を…
lines.en: He got lost — truly, what an inconvenience for you…
lines.style: A real apology directed at Takeda. Half-bow.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 大丈夫ですよ。お子さん、落ち着いて待ってました。
lines.style: Praises the kid before reassuring the mom. Practiced.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじさん、ジュースくれた。
lines.style: A small honest report — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当に、ありがとうございます。今、お礼…
lines.en: Truly — thank you so much. Now, a token…
lines.style: Reaching into her bag in the voice. A real fluster.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: いえいえ、お気持ちだけで。お気をつけて。
lines.en: No, no — your sentiment is enough. Please take care.
lines.style: A small polite refusal. Already turning to the next form.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: はい…本当にありがとうございました。
lines.style: A real bow. Voice steadier now.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A small bright wave. The whole encounter resolved.
